items.claim: Dante Johnson is the more explosive athlete in his matchup.
items.quote: Dante Johnson has a lot of paths. Well, he doesn't have a lot. He has a few paths to win this fight, um and a lot of them range around doing more and being the more explosive athlete.

items.claim: Eric McConico has a patient and savvy counter-striking style.
items.quote: Eric McConico has that kind of that that patient savvy about him, right? And I think he can use a lot of the counter striking and kind of do just enough

items.claim: Jalin Turner retired and then came back to competition.
items.quote: he did retire in there and then come back. So, he's one and 0 since coming back from retirement

items.claim: Kaue Fernandes has a record of 11 wins and 2 losses.
items.quote: Kaue Fernandes is four and one in his last five fights, an impressive 11 and two on the career.

items.claim: Kaue Fernandes throws leg kicks with very little tell, making them hard for opponents to anticipate.
items.quote: he's got absolutely no tell on those kicks... most fighters have not had any idea that he's about to kick them, and that's why they keep getting hurt with the hurt to the leg.

items.claim: Kaue Fernandes has good top pressure and scrambling ability.
items.quote: He's uh does a good job of advancing position. He's got good top pressure. He scrambles really well.

items.claim: Kaue Fernandes's constant submission attempts from the bottom can lead to him giving away control time if they fail.
items.quote: if you're constantly throwing up armbars and you don't get them, you've just given away a lot of minutes where you're being controlled on the mat.

items.claim: Jalin Turner excels at maintaining his range while pressuring forward due to his long frame.
items.quote: He's really good at maintaining his range while still pressuring forward. And because he's so long and lanky, he can kind of keep people at the edge of the wood chipper

items.claim: Jalin Turner's takedown defense needs a lot of work.
items.quote: defensively his takedowns uh takedown defense could use a lot of work, but he is hard We've seen a lot of guys take him down

items.claim: Jalin Turner is difficult for opponents to hold down on the mat despite being taken down.
items.quote: not many people have been able just to hold him down.
